chunks: 5121 - Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic:

“The punishment of those who wage war against Allah and His Messenger and strive to spread corruption in the land is only that they be killed, or crucified, or have their hands and feet cut off from opposite sides, or be exiled from the land.”

He said: “If he kills and does not wage war and does not take wealth, he is killed. If he wages war and kills, he is killed and crucified. If he wages war and takes wealth but does not kill, his hand and foot are cut off. And if he wages war but does not kill and does not take wealth, he is exiled.”

key_terms.فَسَادًا: corruption and violent disorder spread in the land
key_terms.مِنْ خِلَافٍ: from opposite sides, meaning opposite hand and foot
key_terms.نُفِيَ: he is exiled or banished from the land
key_terms.يُحَارِبُونَ: they wage war or engage in hostile violent aggression
key_terms.يُصَلَّبُوا: they are crucified as a prescribed legal punishment

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explain the punishments in Quran 5:33?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the legal application of the Quranic verse regarding those who wage war and spread فساد in the land. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام clarifies that the punishment varies according to whether the offender killed, fought, or unlawfully took wealth, making the verse a basis for differentiated legal rulings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5121 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:

"The punishment of those who wage war against Allah (swt) and His Messenger and strive to spread corruption on earth is that they be killed, or crucified, or have their hands and feet cut off from opposite sides, or be exiled from the land" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:33).

Imam (as) said: "If a person kills but does not engage in combat and does not take wealth, he is to be executed.
If he engages in combat and kills, he is to be killed and crucified.
If he engages in combat and takes wealth but does not kill, his hand and foot are to be cut off.
And if he engages in combat but does not kill and does not take wealth, he is to be exiled."
